newsitem.title: FRANCE: Seventh person dies in cold spell in France.
newsitem.headline: Seventh person dies in cold spell in France.

text.p: A five-day cold spell claimed a seventh victim in France, police said on Sunday.
They said the body of Charles Ziegler, a 65-year-old man who had been living in a shack without heat or electricity had been found in the hamlet of Lorentzen near Strasbourg in eastern France.
"He died of hypothermia," a police spokesman said.
Six other homeless individuals have died from the cold weather since Wednesday, according to police.
The body of a homeless man, aged 56, was found near a shopping centre in the Paris suburb of Thiais on Saturday.

Shelters have been flooded with calls over the weekend from people worried about homeless individuals after Xavier Emmanuelli, a junior minister in charge of emergency humanitarian action, urged people to help the homeless during the cold spell.
